findings.issue: stream() from another thread inside ex.commit while the handler returns: afterHandler saw COMMITTED and left, nobody ran or aborted the copy
findings.disposition: fixed: afterHandler/afterFailure set handlerDone (and handlerFailure) under the lock; stream() entering STREAMING after that runs runTransfer or abort itself; test sdsAc4_sdsAc5_FR_HTTP_014_AC5_AC7_streamCommittingWhileTheHandlerReturnsStillCopiesAndCloses

findings.issue: commit/finish may reach an exchange already aborted by a concurrent abort
findings.disposition: accepted: HttpExchange.abort is idempotent and commit/finish on an aborted exchange fail into the abort path

findings.issue: null contentType from Java leaks the input
findings.disposition: accepted: the package is @NullMarked; null is a contract violation

findings.issue: Error during runTransfer left the exchange open
findings.disposition: fixed: runTransfer aborts on Error and rethrows, matching Dispatcher.invoke
